summary: Review time-to-event analyses for time origin, censoring, competing risks, proportional-hazards assumptions and estimand interpretation.

must_inspect.why: The time origin and censoring mechanism must match the scientific question.
false_positive_guards: Censoring is not automatically informative; assess the assumption and context.

must_inspect.why: Hazard ratios and cumulative incidence answer different questions and must not be translated casually into absolute risk.
false_positive_guards: Do not require proportional hazards when a different valid estimand/model is used.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
